question: Two groups perform the same chant. Group A keeps an even beat; Group B speeds up and loses words. Which group reproduces the rhythm more accurately? Which reason best supports the correct choice?
audio_prompt: Two groups perform the same chant. Group A keeps an even beat; Group B speeds up and loses words. Which group reproduces the rhythm more accurately? Which reason best supports the correct choice?

answers.text: The correct choice is simply the most formal-sounding option.
A steady repeated beat reproduces the chant's rhythm more accurately.
The correct choice works even if the situation and audience are ignored.

explanation.summary: A steady repeated beat reproduces the chant's rhythm more accurately.
explanation.hint: Judge the pattern and control, not the speed alone.
